1860 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not a century year unless divisible by 400, so 1860 is leap).  
May 20 is day 141 of leap year (Jan 31 + Feb 29 + Mar 31 + Apr 30 + 20 = 141).  
314 days later: 141 + 314 = 455 days from start of year.  
455 - 366 = 89 days into 1861.  
89 days: Jan 31, Feb 28 (1861 not leap), Mar 31 → 31+28=59, 89-59=30 → March 30, 1861.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1861-03-30
